name: ActionGroup
description: a group of action buttons that can collapse to an overflow menu when space is constrained
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: Overflow panel is a closed popover (or `hidden`, without the Popover API) when closed
keyboard: Tab: Move focus into and out of the group
Arrow keys: Move between the controls and wrap, swapped in right-to-left; one tab stop that follows focus; the overflow menu keeps its own
Home, End: Jump to the first or last control
Enter / Space: Activate focused button or toggle overflow
Escape: Closes the overflow menu when open (the Popover API's)

nativePlatform.uses: popover="auto" overflow menu opened by command="toggle-popover" commandfor (and popovertarget) on the overflow trigger; bindable overflowOpen synced from the toggle event
